title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 061
review_goal: Differentiate fullscreen exit, game, and gift variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Four inward corner marks framing centered empty space inside an open square
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants exit fullscreen shown by inward corner brackets instead of arrows.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the inward arrows variant when arrowheads should point toward the center.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows four separated corner brackets closing inward around a blank center.

items.depicts_observation: Two diagonal arrow marks pointing inward toward upper left and lower right corners
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants exit fullscreen shown by inward diagonal arrows instead of bracket corners.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the corner bracket variant when no arrowheads should appear.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot replaces the corner marks with two arrowheads aimed inward along a diagonal.

items.depicts_observation: Oval gamepad body with one centered dot button and one plus pad inside
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a rounded oval controller with one dot button and one plus pad.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the wavy controller when the outer body should curve like a console gamepad shell.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot draws the controller as a smooth oval body with the controls spaced inside it.

items.depicts_observation: Wavy gamepad body with one centered dot button and one plus pad inside
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a controller with a wavy outer shell and the same inner button layout.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the oval gamepad when the body should stay smooth and rounded.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot changes the outer body into a pinched wavy controller shape while keeping the controls inside.

items.depicts_observation: Tall gift box shape with a centered ribbon cross and one bow mark above
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a tall wrapped present with a vertical ribbon crossing the front.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the squarer gift box when the proportions should be wider and more even.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a slightly taller box with one bow on top and ribbons crossing the center.
